descriptionHtml:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data zu treffen? Unser Team unterstützt von der Definition der AI & Data-Strategie über die Implementierung groß angelegter Datenplattformen und Visual Analytics Programme bis hin zu Einführung smarter "Age of With"-Lösungen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Consultant Data Science & ML Engineering (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, Mannheim, München und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als Consultant Data Science & ML Engineering (m/w/d) unterstützt du unsere Kunden dabei, Daten in messbaren Geschäftswert zu verwandeln und moderne Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Lösungen erfolgreich umzusetzen.

  • Konzeption: Du unterstützt bei der Identifikation von Potenzialen für Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Lösungen, analysierst Anforderungen und Datenquellen und wirkst bei der Bewertung des geschäftlichen Nutzens neuer Anwendungsfälle mit.
  • Analyse: Du analysierst Datenbestände, bewertest deren Qualität und leitest gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam wertvolle Erkenntnisse für datengetriebene Entscheidungen ab.
  • Lösungsentwicklung & Umsetzung: Du entwickelst und implementierst unter Anleitung erfahrener Kolleg:innen Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Modelle und unterstützt dabei, fachliche Anforderungen in datenbasierte Lösungen zu überführen.
  • Operationalisierung: Du wirkst bei der Integration, dem Testing und der Produktivsetzung von Analytics- und ML-Lösungen mit und unterstützt den Aufbau nachhaltiger MLOps-Prozesse.
  • Innovation: Du bringst dich bei der Evaluierung neuer Methoden, Frameworks und Technologien im Bereich Data Science und Machine Learning ein und unterstützt die prototypische Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen.

Dein Skillset:

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung, Umsetzung oder Produktivsetzung von Data-Science-, Analytics- oder Machine-Learning-Lösungen im Unternehmenskontext
  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise in den Fachrichtungen Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Statistikbezug, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Python und SQL sowie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Frameworks wie beispielsweise scikit-learn, LightGBM oder vergleichbaren Technologien
  • Grundkenntnisse in statistischen Verfahren, Machine Learning sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit MLOps-Tools, Cloud-Plattformen (Azure, AWS oder GCP) oder der Produktivsetzung datengetriebener Anwendungen
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch (C1) und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift

Deine Chance:

  • Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
  • Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits
  • Work-Life-Balance durch Mobile Working & Teilzeit, EU Remote Working, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt
  • Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation, z. B. durch [bitte fachspezifisches Training einsetzen]
  • Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!

Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.

Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen

Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.

descriptionHtml:
Nicht jeder kann von sich behaupten, die Welt zu ernähren, aber es ist ein Teil unseres Alltags. Hinter allem, was wir für unsere Landwirtinnen und Landwirte tun, steht ein AGCO Team. Wir sind stolz darauf, innovative Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen und zu einer besseren und nachhaltigeren Welt beizutragen. Werden Sie noch heute Teil unseres außergewöhnlichen Teams!

Ihr Beitrag

  • Sie identifizieren gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Domänenexperten datengetriebene Anwendungsfälle und entwickeln daraus innovative Analyse- und KI-Lösungen
  • Sie entwickeln Modelle und analytische Methoden zur Bewertung, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Produkten, Maschinen und Prozessen
  • Sie nutzen strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten, um wertvolle Erkenntnisse zu generieren und datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu unterstützen
  • Sie gestalten moderne KI- und Analytics-Lösungen, die Engineering- und Entwicklungsteams bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit unterstützen
  • Sie kommunizieren verständlich und stellen die Qualität, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit von Analyseergebnissen, Modellen und Datenprodukten sicher

Ihre Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Interpretation komplexer Datensätze, idealerweise im Umfeld der Maschinen-, Landmaschinen- oder Fahrzeugentwicklung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Python, SQL und modernen Data-Science- und Machine-Learning-Frameworks wie Pandas, Spark, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, Mosaic AI, PyTorch oder TensorFlow
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Generative AI- und LLM-Anwendungen sowie der sicheren Anwendung statistischer Methoden, Machine Learning und Datenvisualisierung auf Cloud- und Analytics-Plattformen wie Databricks, AWS oder GCP
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe analytische Ergebnisse verständlich zu kommunizieren und erfolgreich mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammenzuarbeiten

Ihre Benefits

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung mit Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld, gemäß Tarifvertrag sowie weitere tarifliche Sonderzahlungen
  • Eine wertschätzende, teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur in guter Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • Möglichkeit zusätzlicher Versicherungen und Altersvorsorgemodelle

descriptionHtml:
Your career at Deutsche Börse Group

This position is limited until 31.12.2027.

Your area of work

Group Credit and Clearstream Risk Management’s overriding objective is to ensure that business activities are conducted within a prudent risk management framework that is consistent with the institution’s credit appetite and in compliance with regulatory and supervisory requirements. We are searching for a Quantitative Analyst to maintain, further develop and oversee quantitative risk models, collateral models and rating models. A successful candidate will take ownership of the development, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement to our quantitative models and methodologies. Furthermore, as part of the group-wide Credit and Risk Team, s/he will assume responsibility for the related reporting, ad hoc reviews, investigations and special assignments as required to senior management.

Your Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve quantitative rating and risk models used for credit and risk management
  • Define, document and manage processes required for the maintenance of rating and risk models in their productive states; take ownership for continuous improvements to the existing methodologies and model monitoring tools; address any related findings as revealed by model monitoring or model validation
  • Regularly review the adequacy and robustness of applied risk models and perform model calibrations, undertake impact assessments and report on the results, where applicable
  • Work in close collaboration with model users and IT to accompany IT development process, including writing business requirements, taking into consideration the available (or planned) infrastructure, as well as performing business acceptance testing
  • Deliver insightful management information in support of senior management and committee review
  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and regulatory authorities
  • Maintain internal model inventory. Support the team’s regular tasks


Your profile


  • Master's degree in mathematics, computer science, physics or a related quantitative field
  • 2-3 years of experience in the end-to-end development, implementation, and validation of credit rating models, with direct involvement in model specification, calibration, performance monitoring, and backtesting
  • expertise in quantitative risk modelling, especially in the context of creditworthiness assessment and rating assignment, with a strong grasp of methodologies such as logistic regression, scorecard development, and machine learning techniques applied to credit risk
  • Comprehensive understanding of regulatory requirements for rating models (e.g., CSDR, CRR, BCBS, MaRisk), including the preparation of model documentation and support for regulatory submissions
  • Strong programming skills in relevant languages (e.g., Python (incl. NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, PySpark,…), or similar) for data analysis, model development, and automation of model processes and strong knowledge in Development Tools like Azure DataBricks, GitHub etc.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets, identify data quality issues, and derive actionable insights to improve model accuracy and performance
  • Meticulous attention to detail, robust analytical and problem-solving skills, and sound professional judgement
  • High commitment, team spirit, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, ability to effectively operate across various functions and business areas
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English. German and/or French will be an asset

descriptionHtml:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!


The Role

• Build, operate, and continuously develop an AI-based knowledge platform, serving as the technological core for an AI Factory, ensuring reliable, performant, and cost-efficient LLM services in production.

• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for real-world product use cases, covering document ingestion, indexing, retrieval, context preparation, and generative responses.

• Construct, operate, and optimize vector databases and search infrastructures, ensuring clean data models, relevance, low latency, and robust monitoring.

• Select, tune, and orchestrate embedding models and LLMs, managing their lifecycle and implementing AI workflows using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.

• Shape architectural decisions, evaluation frameworks, and technical standards in collaboration with AI/ML engineering, application teams, and business units, integrating relevant Generative AI/LLM ecosystem developments.


What You'll Need

• Several years of experience building and operating RAG systems, search infrastructures, or knowledge-based platforms, ideally in a regulated or mission-critical environment.

• A completed degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Mathematics, or a comparable field, with a strong commitment to scientific and technical excellence.

• Deep understanding of vector databases, embeddings, retrieval strategies, and LLM integration, with proven experience in building production-ready solutions.

• Proficiency with cloud-based AI platforms (preferably Azure AI) and orchestration frameworks like LangChain, including monitoring, security, performance, and cost optimization.

• A strong ownership mindset, excellent analytical and communication skills, and a passion for interdisciplinary collaboration to transform knowledge utilization in healthcare.


What's On Offer

• Competitive salary

• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development through tailored training programs.

• Access to wellness facilities, including a modern gym and sports courses, to promote a healthy work-life balance.

• Support for work-life integration, including flexible working arrangements and on-site childcare options.


Apply via Haystack today!

descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Data Scientist based in Germany.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a senior data science professional to help shape the future of statistical modeling and machine learning in residential real estate valuation.

You will work closely with executive technical leadership to solve complex, open-ended statistical and engineering problems.

The role combines hands-on development with the creation of new valuation methodologies and production-grade analytical systems.

Your work will directly support products and platforms used by consumers, financial stakeholders, and professional appraisers across the United States.

The focus is on interpretable machine learning, statistical modeling, optimization, uncertainty estimation, and reliable production systems rather than deep learning or LLM research.

As the Data Science organization grows, you will also help establish technical standards, mentor future team members, and influence its long-term direction.

This role is ideal for a technically strong, curious problem solver who enjoys turning novel analytical ideas into trusted software.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and implement production-quality statistical and machine learning systems for residential property valuation and related analytical applications.
  • Partner directly with technical leadership to develop innovative valuation methodologies and solve challenging statistical problems that may not have established solutions.
  • Translate research concepts and analytical ideas into scalable, maintainable, production-ready software.
  • Design rigorous evaluation frameworks to measure model performance, reliability, accuracy, and robustness, and continuously improve analytical outcomes.
  • Develop methodologies for complex use cases, including rare and atypical properties, confidence estimation, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Build interpretable machine learning systems that provide transparent and defensible results for consumers and professional users.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineering teams to integrate new analytical capabilities into production systems.
  • Improve the reliability, maintainability, testing, and overall engineering quality of the machine learning platform.
  • Establish technical standards, modeling practices, and engineering best practices for the Data Science function.
  • Contribute to technical hiring, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and the development of future Data Science team members.
  • Help shape the long-term technical direction and capabilities of the growing Data Science organization.

Requirements

  • Strong professional background in machine learning and statistics, with experience applying advanced analytical techniques to complex business or technical problems.
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying production-quality machine learning systems rather than working exclusively in research or experimental environments.
  • Excellent Python programming skills and strong software engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience with testing, version control, modular architecture, maintainable code, and other practices required for reliable production software.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, interpretable machine learning, optimization, and rigorous model evaluation.
  • Ability to reason from first principles and solve ambiguous, open-ended problems where established methodologies may not exist.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to develop elegant and defensible solutions to difficult statistical and engineering challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative approach to solving challenging technical problems, with the ability to give and receive constructive technical feedback.
  • Ability and interest in mentoring colleagues, contributing to technical standards, and helping shape a growing Data Science organization.
  • A senior or staff-level mindset, with the technical depth and ownership required to influence modeling, engineering, and organizational direction.

Benefits

  • Compensation range of $225,000-$250,000 per year.
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact statistical and machine learning systems used in residential real estate valuation.
  • Direct collaboration with senior technical leadership on challenging and open-ended analytical problems.
  • Hands-on ownership of production machine learning systems and next-generation valuation methodologies.
  • Opportunity to influence technical standards, engineering practices, hiring, and the long-term direction of a growing Data Science organization.
  • Significant potential for increased technical leadership responsibilities as the team expands.
  • Opportunity to work on interpretable and explainable machine learning systems where accuracy, transparency, and defensibility are critical.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
Your career at Deutsche Börse Group

This position is limited until 31.12.2027.

Your area of work

Group Credit and Clearstream Risk Management’s overriding objective is to ensure that business activities are conducted within a prudent risk management framework that is consistent with the institution’s credit appetite and in compliance with regulatory and supervisory requirements. We are searching for a Quantitative Analyst to maintain, further develop and oversee quantitative risk models, collateral models and rating models. A successful candidate will take ownership of the development, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement to our quantitative models and methodologies. Furthermore, as part of the group-wide Credit and Risk Team, s/he will assume responsibility for the related reporting, ad hoc reviews, investigations and special assignments as required to senior management.

Your Responsibilities


  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve quantitative rating and risk models used for credit and risk management
  • Define, document and manage processes required for the maintenance of rating and risk models in their productive states; take ownership for continuous improvements to the existing methodologies and model monitoring tools; address any related findings as revealed by model monitoring or model validation
  • Regularly review the adequacy and robustness of applied risk models and perform model calibrations, undertake impact assessments and report on the results, where applicable
  • Work in close collaboration with model users and IT to accompany IT development process, including writing business requirements, taking into consideration the available (or planned) infrastructure, as well as performing business acceptance testing
  • Deliver insightful management information in support of senior management and committee review
  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and regulatory authorities
  • Maintain internal model inventory. Support the team’s regular tasks


Your profile


  • Master's degree in mathematics, computer science, physics or a related quantitative field
  • 2-3 years of experience in the end-to-end development, implementation, and validation of credit rating models, with direct involvement in model specification, calibration, performance monitoring, and backtesting
  • expertise in quantitative risk modelling, especially in the context of creditworthiness assessment and rating assignment, with a strong grasp of methodologies such as logistic regression, scorecard development, and machine learning techniques applied to credit risk
  • Comprehensive understanding of regulatory requirements for rating models (e.g., CSDR, CRR, BCBS, MaRisk), including the preparation of model documentation and support for regulatory submissions
  • Strong programming skills in relevant languages (e.g., Python (incl. NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, PySpark,…), or similar) for data analysis, model development, and automation of model processes and strong knowledge in Development Tools like Azure DataBricks, GitHub etc.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets, identify data quality issues, and derive actionable insights to improve model accuracy and performance
  • Meticulous attention to detail, robust analytical and problem-solving skills, and sound professional judgement
  • High commitment, team spirit, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, ability to effectively operate across various functions and business areas
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English. German and/or French will be an asset

descriptionHtml:
Chair of Biological Imaging

13.08.2026, Academic staff

Join us in shaping the future of biomedical imaging

 We are looking for a curious and persistent PhD student (f/m/d) who wants to discover new biological and medical insights from cutting-edge imaging and sensing technologies.

The Chair of Biological Imaging (CBI) at the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and the Institute of Biological and Medical Imaging (IBMI) at Helmholtz Munich form one of Europe's leading centers for biomedical imaging and sensing innovation. Our mission is to create transformative technologies that reveal previously inaccessible biological information and accelerate breakthroughs in medicine, biology, and environmental health.

Our interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers from more than 25 countries develops technologies that bridge fundamental research, clinical translation, and real-world healthcare impact. With state-of-the-art infrastructure, strong industrial partnerships, and a proven track record of innovation, IBMI offers an exceptional environment for ambitious researchers seeking to work at the forefront of bioengineering.

The Opportunity

What biological information is hidden in biomedical imaging data – and how can we extract it reliably? We are looking for a curious and persistent PhD student (f/m/d) who wants to discover new biological and medical insights from cutting-edge imaging and sensing technologies. You will work at the interface of data science, imaging technology and biomedical research, developing analysis strategies for complex real-world datasets ranging from preclinical experiments to human studies.

We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding complex datasets in depth: identifying limitations and confounders, working with developers to understand the imaging pipeline, and finding robust ways to extract biological information even when datasets are small, heterogeneous or noisy.

We value scientific curiosity and persistence over blind application of standard pipelines. The right candidate will want to understand why an analysis works, what information it uses, when it fails, and how confident we can be in its conclusions. You will work with unique datasets generated by cutting-edge optoacoustic imaging and sensing technologies, with the goal of discovering biological and medical information that has not yet been fully exploited.

You will have the freedom to ask what information is contained in these data and develop the computational and statistical approaches needed to extract it. Working closely with experts in imaging technology, algorithm development, biology, and medicine, you will be able to understand the entire path from physical measurements to biological interpretation and develop robust analysis approaches tailored to challenging real-world biomedical data.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

  • Analyze unique preclinical and clinical imaging datasets and uncover novel biological and medical insights.
  • Develop innovative data analysis, image analysis, statistical, and machine learning methods, choosing the approach that best fits the scientific question.
  • Investigate systematically what information is contained in imaging data, how it can be extracted, and how confidently conclusions can be drawn.
  • Develop and apply approaches for uncertainty quantification, robust inference, and validation of biomedical imaging results.
  • Work directly with biologists, biomedical researchers, and clinicians to formulate relevant questions and interpret findings in their biological and medical context.
  • Contribute to turning advanced imaging and sensing technologies into tools that generate new biological understanding and clinically relevant information.

This position is embedded within major research and innovation programs funded by the European Union and the German government and offers exceptional opportunities for scientific visibility, professional growth, and future leadership.

Your Profile

Required Qualifications

  • Education in Data Science, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or related disciplines with a strong academic record.
  • Strong background in data analysis, statistics, machine learning, scientific computing, or related computational methods.
  • Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience working with scientific data.
  • Strong interest in using computational methods to discover biological or medical insights from imaging and sensing data.
  • Curiosity and willingness to engage with both the technical foundations of imaging methods and the biological or medical questions behind the data.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Independent, proactive, and collaborative working style.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.
  • Enthusiasm for interdisciplinary teamwork in an international research environment.

Particularly advantageous

  • Strong knowledge of statistics, statistical learning, or probabilistic modeling.
  • Experience collaborating with experimental scientists, biologists, or clinicians.
  • Interest or experience in LLMs, tool-using agents, or agentic workflows.
  • Experience in optoacoustics, ultrasound, optical imaging, spectroscopy, or related technologies.
  • Interest in entrepreneurship, innovation transfer, or commercialization.

li>Fluency in German and English.

Our Offer

This Position Is Your Opportunity To Help Create a New Generation Of Medical Technology And Medical Impact With High Dissemination And Commercialization Potential. You Will Work In One Of The World's Leading Centers For Optoacoustic Imaging And Gain Direct Exposure To The Entire Innovation Pipeline, From Technology Invention And System Engineering To Clinical Validation And Regulatory Translation. We Offer

  • Participation in a highly ambitious, internationally visible research program.
  • Access to state-of-the-art imaging, photonics, electronics, and biomedical research infrastructure.
  • Close interaction with world-leading experts in imaging, bioengineering, and clinical medicine.
  • Opportunities to contribute to patents, technology transfer, and future commercialization activities.
  • Extensive international networking and collaboration opportunities.
  • TUM offers a wide variety of inspiring and challenging PhD programs, which will supplement your research training with outstanding opportunities for career development, continued education and life-long learning.
  • A dynamic, supportive, and highly collaborative working environment.

Life in Munich

Located at the foothills of the Alps, Munich is consistently ranked among the world’s most livable cities. It offers a unique ecosystem for scientific excellence, innovation, and entrepreneurship.

Contract and Conditions

The position is initially offered for 3 years, with the possibility of extension and long-term career perspectives based on performance and mutual interests. Compensation is according to TV EntgO Bund EG13-75% according to the public wage agreement of the Federal Republic of German. Helmholtz Munich and TUM are committed to diversity, equal opportunity, and inclusion. Applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds are warmly encouraged. The position is suitable for filling with severely disabled persons. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference granted otherwise essentially equal suitability, ability and professional performance.

Your Application

Please Submit Your Application (preferably In English), Including

  • CV
  • Motivation letter (please specify the title of the position you are applying for)
  • Academic transcripts of records

Apply here: online application

Job Number: R0246839

Air and Missile Defense Data Visualization Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a client-facing Data Visualization Analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with our Integrated Air and Missile defense customers across the joint force, planners, analysts, and mission partners to understand their questions and needs, then dig into data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deeper understanding of their data, but you’ll also advise the client on what the information means and how it can be used to improve planning, assessment, partner engagement, and senior leader decision-making. Through gaining efficiency and accuracy, this position will enable leaders within the Joint Integrated Air and Missile Defense community better understand and display trends, gaps, risks, and opportunities across U.S., Allied, partner nation programs and operational activities.

How You’ll Contribute:

  • Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships with respect to Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD).
  • Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, cleaning, interpretation, evaluation, integration, and analysis of operational and assessment data.
  • Contribute to impactful work and guide rapid decision-making across IAMD planners, assessment analysts, operational environment analysts, and senior stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Service components to institute common operational pictures to provide real-time data-driven information to enable customers to make rapid assessments and accelerate decision-making cycles.
  • Apply communication skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements, data trends, and analytical findings based on audience.
  • Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, Maven, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or R, visualization tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Apply data visualization through formats including, but not limited to Maven, dashboards, graphs, tables, trackers, maps, and PowerPoint.
  • Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across the Integrated Air and Missile defense enterprise in the US European Command Area of responsibility through campaign assessments, Allied and partner nation engagements, and operational planning missions.


Work with us to drive large-scale decisions through data insights, specializing in IAMD information.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have: 

  • 3+ years of experience in application development, AI and ML engineering, software engineering, or data science
  • 3+ years of experience designing, developing, operationalizing, and maintaining complex software or machine learning applications at enterprise scale
  • 1+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing, and processing structured and unstructured data to support machine learning workflows
  • 1+ years of experience with building scalable data pipelines, ETL and ELT workflows, or model training and deployment pipelines
  • Experience creating solutions within a collaborative and cross-functional team environment
  • Ability to code and develop scalable solutions from scratch using languages such as Python or TypeScript
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, problem-solve creatively, and operate with minimal supervision
  • Ability to develop scripts and programs for converting various types of data into usable formats and support project teams to scale, monitor, and operate AI/ML platforms
  • TS/SCI clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mathematics and 3+ years of experience in a professional work environment, or 7+ years of experience in a professional work environment in lieu of a degree


Nice If You Have: 

  • Experience with Palantir tools, such as Foundry
  • Experience with Full-Stack application development for deploying ML models
  • Experience with distributed data or computing tools, including Databricks
  • Experience working on real-time data, streaming applications, or AI model deployment
  • Knowledge of U.S. Joint Force Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) or Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD) combat systems, data architectures, Command and Control, and IAMD information concepts


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $99,000.00 to $225,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

descriptionHtml:
Als Industrieunternehmen sammeln wir an vielen Stellen wertvolle Daten – in kaufmännischen Abteilungen, in technischen Bereichen und direkt in der Produktion. Ihre Auswertung hilft uns dabei, Abläufe zu verbessern und effizienter zu gestalten. Dafür ist ein dauerhaftes und strukturiertes Datenmanagement unverzichtbar. Die Zukunft basiert auf der Analyse komplexer Daten. Nur wer diese richtig auswerten und interpretieren kann, sorgt für reibungslose Prozesse und treibt Innovationen voran. Durch verständliche Datenvisualisierungen wird zudem für alle sichtbar, wo Optimierungen möglich sind und welche Maßnahmen echten Mehrwert bringen. Der Studiengang Data Science wird bei uns mit der Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker kombiniert – eine starke Verbindung aus theoretischem Know-how und praktischer Erfahrung, um die digitale Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

, Your Tasks,

  • Du erhebst und analysierst große Datenmengen
  • Zusätzlich verdichtest und visualisierst du Informationen für optimale Entscheidungsprozesse
  • Dabei analysierst und wertest du Daten von ERP-System für eine Optimierung der Prozesse aus

Details zum Dualen Studium:

  • Hochschule: Technische Hochschule Ostwestfalen-Lippe, Lemgo

  • Ausbildungsberuf: Fachinformatiker m/w/d

, Your Profile,

  • Du hast oder wirst eine gute Fachhochschulreife oder allgemeine Hochschulreife erwerben
  • Analytisches Denken fällt dir leicht
  • Du zeigst persönliches Engagement und Neugierde
  • Darüber hinaus bist du leistungsorientiert und gut organisiert
  • Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit runden dein Profil ab

Folgende Fächer sind im Dualen Studium Data Science integriert:

  • Mathematik für Datenwissenschaften
  • Datenerfassung und Datenhaltung
  • Datensicherheit
  • Maschinelles Lernen
  • Programmiersprachen
  • Algorithmen und Datenstrukturen
  • Software LifeCycle Management
  • Hier bekommst du alle Details zum Studiengang - einfach dem Link folgen und mehr erfahren!

descriptionHtml:
• Role: Machine Learning (AI) Engineer (Hybrid)
  • Location: Remote
  • Job Type: Full-Time
  • Payout: $200K - $500K/yr


Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an AI/ML Engineer to develop and deploy machine learning models that power core product features. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to design scalable AI solutions that enhance user experience and operational efficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

• Design, train, and optimize machine learning models using Python, TensorFlow, and PyTorch frameworks.

• Develop and maintain data pipelines to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation.

• Implement MLOps practices to streamline model deployment, monitoring, and version control.

• Collaborate with data scientists and software engineers to integrate AI capabilities into production systems.

• Conduct performance benchmarking and A/B testing to validate model accuracy and business impact.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Proficiency in Python, TensorFlow, and PyTorch for model development and training.

• Experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker for deployment and monitoring.

• Strong background in data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for scalable AI infrastructure.

• Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.


More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development industry, contributing to the advancement of AI-driven product solutions. The position involves solving complex technical challenges in a collaborative environment with access to cutting-edge tools and datasets.


Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.


Apply Now!

Unsere Arbeit verbindet mobiles Sensing, Software Engineering und medizinische Forschung mit dem Ziel, skalierbare und nutzerfreundliche digitale Gesundheitstechnologien zu entwickeln.

  • Zugang zu einer exzellenten Forschungsinfrastruktur am Universitätsklinikum Bonn
  • Enge Betreuung und Unterstützung bei der wissenschaftlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Möglichkeit zur Promotion und zur Veröffentlichung wissenschaftlicher Ergebnisse
  • Teilnahme an nationalen und internationalen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen
  • Offene, kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem motivierten und engagierten Team
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Gleitzeit und Homeoffice Möglichkeit

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed.

Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity.

K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners.

Please submit your CV in English

About The Role

We are looking for a visionary ML/AI Scientist to co-lead the development of our AI Scientist—an autonomous agentic system designed to navigate the complexities of drug discovery, in collaboration with our Platform Biology team and our Product team. This role is about building a "scientists in a box" that can reason over biological data, design experiments, and autonomously drive therapeutic breakthroughs. Unlike traditional ML roles that focus on single-task optimization, you will be building a meta-researcher. You’ll be at the heart of Owkin’s mission, creating the engine that will discover the next generation of life-saving therapeutics.

In Particular, You Will

  • Architect Agentic Systems: Design and implement sophisticated AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, tool-use, and self-correction.
  • Bridge AI and Wet-Lab: Develop frameworks where agents can propose hypotheses and design "optimal experiments" to be validated in a wet-lab.
  • Scale the "Hacker" Approach: Rapidly prototype and iterate on agentic architectures, moving from paper to production-grade code with speed and precision.
  • Scientific Leadership: Maintain a watch on the frontier of GenAI and Agentic workflows, publishing high-impact research at the intersection of AI, Biology and Chemistry.

About You

The successful candidate possesses a "hacker spirit", e.g., you don’t just wait for the perfect dataset, you build the tools to find it. You are independent, deeply curious, and obsessed with the idea of automating the scientific method.

Core Requirements

  • Demonstrated Expertise in Agentic AI: Deep understanding of LLM reasoning (Chain-of-Thought, ReAct), long-context management, and tool-augmented generation.
  • The Hacker Toolkit: Expert-level Python skills with a focus on "building." You should be comfortable writing clean, modular code that interfaces with complex APIs and databases.
  • Technical Foundation: PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or Applied Mathematics (or equivalent high-level industry experience).
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex agent behaviors to both AI peers and biological experts. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Fluent in English (French is a plus).
  • Team first, highly collaborative mindset.

Preferred Qualifications (The "Big Plus")

We are especially interested in candidates who bring Computational Biology or Chemistry expertise to the table.

  • Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the "central dogma" data stack, from processing raw sequencing (omics) to interpreting the physics and geometry of macromolecular structures.
  • Closed-loop Discovery: Experience in Active Learning, Bayesian Optimization, or Optimal Experimental Design.
  • Systems Engineering: Experience training and deploying large-scale models or managing complex multi-agent orchestrations.
  • Causal Inference: Experience in understanding "response to treatment" or causal discovery in biological systems.
  • Industry Impact: Proven track record of taking a research concept and turning it into a functional tool used by other scientists.
  • Publication Record: History of contributions to top-tier journals or ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or equivalent online content (e.g. github; patents; etc…).

Ref

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization
  • Friendly and informal working environment
  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.
  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.
  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:
  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.
  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).
  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn and Job Teaser, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.
  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;
  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger
  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn
  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/
  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities
  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address hiring@owkin.com
  • contact the following authorities:
    • [FR] https://internet-signalement.gouv.fr/
    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime
    • [US] https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Risk Analyst – B2B (m/f/d) (unlimited, full-time)

Join our team at our location in Berlin, Verl, Amsterdam, Heerenveen, Luxembourg – flexible working conditions available

We are looking for a Risk Analyst – B2B for our Risk Analytics team in the Client Underwriting Unit with a hands-on attitude that is keen to have an impact on our risk assessment by mitigating risk in terms of affordability / solvency for the B2B end customer in a balanced risk decision environment.

The focus of the team lies on contributing to the definition of our risk strategy in the B2B space, its (further) development and the constant monitoring and steering according to it.

In line with Riverty's overarching vision to become the most human-centric FinTech, the Risk Analytics team develops appropriate customer risk strategies for different markets and ecosystems. The organization is characterized by technology-based rapid learning and decision-making cycles and guided by a strong common purpose to jointly create value for all stakeholders. Strong footprint in DACH/NL & Nordics with further expansion ambition within Europe, e. g. UK , Italy.

The Main Responsibilities Are

  • Lead the redesign of B2B underwriting models, including scorecards, decision engines, rule sets, and rating methodologies.
  • Continuous improvement of underlying data analysis and existing business processes to support our B2B product expansion in new countries.
  • Build harmonized multi-country credit frameworks while adapting strategies to local market dynamics, regulations, and data availability.
  • Establish best practices for ad-hoc & deep-dive analyses.
  • Partner with Data Science to build and deploy next-generation ML-based credit models for customers in the B2B space.
  • Enhance reporting frameworks, dashboards, and risk KPIs to support leadership decision-making.
  • You will work in close collaboration with other functions such as Risk Product, Fraud Risk Steering, Data Science, Finance, etc.
  • The function is reporting into the Risk Analytics & Steering Lead, which is reporting into the Functional Unit Lead for Client Underwriting.
  • The location is flexible, preferred locations are Germany (Berlin, Verl), Luxembourg or the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Heerenveen).

Qualifications

What you should bring:

  • Significant experience in B2B risk analytics, ideally within BNPL, lending, payments, or fintech.
  • Relevant experience in a credit risk management environment.
  • Expertise in using various programming languages (SQL / Python / R) to perform complex analytical tasks.
  • Experience in working in an international, agile, cross-functional environment.
  • You embrace new technology and understand the potential of data and advanced analytics.
  • You are a strategic thinker with vision and a strong operator - you get things done.
  • Language: English (mandatory); German or Dutch is a plus.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

descriptionHtml:
Bei KWS treiben wir die Entdeckung und Entwicklung innovativer Pflanzenmerkmale voran, um die Herausforderungen einer nachhaltigeren und produktiveren Landwirtschaft zu bewältigen. Als Computational Biologist (m/w/d) – Genome Editing Trait Discovery übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Identifizierung und Priorisierung von Kandidatengenen für Genome-Editing-Anwendungen. Dabei verbinden Sie biologisches Fachwissen mit modernen datengetriebenen und computergestützten Methoden.

Als Teil unseres Gene Nomination Teams agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle von Biologie, Pflanzenzüchtung, Bioinformatik und Data Science. Sie tragen dazu bei, komplexe Multi-Omics-Datensätze in wertvolle Erkenntnisse zu überführen und innovative Ansätze, darunter Data-Mining- und KI-gestützte Methoden, für die Identifizierung von Kandidatengenen zu entwickeln.

Diese Stelle ist in Vollzeit und unbefristet am Hauptsitz der KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA in Einbeck, Deutschland, zu besetzen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie bringen Ihre biologische Expertise in die Entwicklung, Validierung und Umsetzung KI-gestützter Ansätze zur Identifizierung von Kandidatengenen ein.
  • Sie analysieren, integrieren und interpretieren komplexe Multi-Omics-Datensätze, um die Suche nach Kandidatengenen zur Trait-Entwicklung zu unterstützen.
  • Sie unterstützen Forschungsprojekte und Stakeholder aus Trait Discovery, Breeding Technology Applications und weiteren F&E-Bereichen mit Ihrem Fachwissen in Computational Biology.
  • Sie fungieren als wissenschaftliche Schnittstelle zwischen Biologie, Züchtung, Bioinformatik und Data Science und übersetzen biologische Fragestellungen in datenbasierte Lösungsansätze.
  • Sie bewerten innovative Technologien und moderne computergestützte Methoden, um Geschwindigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Wirkung der Trait Discovery weiter zu steigern.
  • Es besteht die Möglichkeit, eigene wissenschaftliche Projekte in den Bereichen Kandidatengen-Ranking, Knowledge-Discovery-Plattformen und Data Mining zu entwickeln und zu leiten.
  • Sie arbeiten eng mit Data-Science-Teams zusammen, um neue Ansätze in skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Workflows und Plattformen zu überführen.

Bringen Sie Ihr Potenzial ein

  • Promotion (PhD) in Computational Biology, Bioinformatik, Pflanzenwissenschaften, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Analyse und Interpretation umfangreicher biologischer Datensätze, beispielsweise aus Genomik, Transkriptomik, Proteomik oder anderen Omics-Bereichen.
  • Nachgewiesene Expertise in der Anwendung von Data-Mining-, Machine-Learning- und/oder KI-gestützten Methoden zur Identifizierung und Priorisierung von Kandidatengenen.
  • Gutes Verständnis von Pflanzenbiologie, Pflanzenzüchtung, Genetik, Genome Editing oder Prozessen der Trait-Entwicklung.
  • Erfahrung in der Leitung wissenschaftlicher Projekte ist von Vorteil.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Programmiersprachen und Werkzeugen für die wissenschaftliche Datenanalyse, beispielsweise Python, R oder Workflow-Management-Systemen.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken, Innovationsfreude und die Fähigkeit, wissenschaftliche Herausforderungen in kreative Lösungen zu übersetzen.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit und Einflussnahme in interdisziplinären Teams innerhalb einer Matrixorganisation.
  • Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenzen.
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Unser Angebot

  • Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen leben wir mit den Werten Nähe, Verlässlichkeit, Weitblick und Unabhängigkeit - eine Kultur, die auch in der Praxis gelebt wird, z.B. durch eine offene und freundliche Arbeitsatmosphäre.
  • Frei nach dem Motto: „Make yourself grow!“ fördern wir die individuelle berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Wir schaffen das richtige Umfeld für Sie: Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld, Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung, Firmenfahrrad.

Gestalten Sie Ihre Karriere mit KWS und wachsen Sie mit uns! Wir freuen uns auf Ihre digitale Bewerbung über unser Jobportal.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Consultant - Risk & Data Analytics | 60% Reiseanteil | 120.000 EUR + Bonus


Die Chance Unser Mandant zählt zu den weltweit führenden Beratungsunternehmen und ist bekannt dafür, komplexe, hochsensible Herausforderungen für namhafte Konzerne zu lösen. Der Bereich Risk Advisory unterstützt Unternehmen und deren Führungsebene bei geschäftskritischen regulatorischen, rechtlichen und risikobezogenen Fragestellungen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Expertenteams aus den Bereichen Investigations, Streitbeilegung und Risikomanagement.

Für das wachsende Risk Analytics Team in der DACH-Region suchen wir eine(n) Senior Consultant. Das Team unterstützt Mandanten und deren externe Rechtsberater bei hochkarätigen Untersuchungen und Rechtsstreitigkeiten und nutzt dabei Daten und Analytik, um komplexen technischen und regulatorischen Fragestellungen auf den Grund zu gehen.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Verständnis der aktuellen und historischen IT-Landschaft des Mandanten aufbauen und die für eine rechtliche oder regulatorische Fragestellung relevanten Daten identifizieren.
  • Systeme, Datenflüsse und Algorithmen analysieren, um potenzielle Probleme zu erkennen.
  • Große, strukturierte Datensätze extrahieren und analysieren und komplexe Daten in klare Analysen und Visualisierungen überführen.
  • Datenanalytik und Automatisierung einsetzen, um Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen, die sonst aufwändige manuelle Prozesse erfordern würden.
  • Datenmodelle entwickeln und pflegen und Ergebnisse liefern, die direkt von gerichtlich geladenen Sachverständigen, Anwälten und Führungskräften vor Gericht und gegenüber Regulierungsbehörden verwendet werden.
  • Eng mit Anwaltsteams renommierter internationaler Kanzleien zusammenarbeiten und technische Ergebnisse für ein nicht-technisches, juristisches Publikum verständlich aufbereiten.
  • Beim Aufbau eines noch wachsenden Spezialistenteams mitwirken, mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für dessen Weiterentwicklung.


Ihr Profil

  • Rund 1 bis 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem professionellen Geschäftsumfeld, etwa in einer Beratung, einer Big-4-Gesellschaft oder einer internen Risk-/Data-Funktion, mit praktischer Erfahrung in Datenanalytik, Programmierung oder IT.
  • Erfahrung in Risk Advisory, Compliance, Investigations, Datenschutz oder Geldwäscheprävention von Vorteil, Kandidat*innen mit starkem Data-/Analytics-Hintergrund und echtem Interesse an diesem Bereich werden ebenfalls berücksichtigt.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit SQL und Python (oder vergleichbaren Skriptsprachen) sowie Kenntnisse in Databricks und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Power BI oder Tableau.
  • Ein Studienabschluss in einem quantitativen Fach (Mathematik, Physik, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder Ähnliches); ein postgradualer Abschluss ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (nicht zwingend muttersprachlich, aber sicher genug, um vor der Geschäftsführung von Mandanten selbstbewusst zu präsentieren) sowie fließendes Englisch.
  • Eine proaktive, unternehmerische Denkweise und die Fähigkeit, mit einem gewissen Maß an Unklarheit in einem kleinen, schnell wachsenden Team umzugehen.
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen zu Mandanten in der gesamten DACH-Region.


Der Prozess:

Mehrstufiger Interviewprozess (Erstgespräch, fallbasierte Interviews, Online-Assessment, abschließendes Gespräch mit einem Partner), in der Regel 6 bis 8 Wochen von Anfang bis Ende.

descriptionHtml:
BITA is a Fintech company with a mission to disrupt the index and systematic investment industries. Through advanced software, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and high-quality data, we empower our clients to develop innovative investment products faster, more flexibly, and at a lower cost. We are a young and dynamic team located worldwide, united by a strong belief that the investment industry is ready for a new challenger.


We are looking for a Senior Product Development Specialist to join our Product Development team in Frankfurt. You will contribute across the lifecycle of new index and systematic investment products, from research and methodology design through prototyping, backtesting, implementation, and commercial launch. A key part of the role is translating quantitative research into robust and practical technical solutions and applying AI and machine learning where they can improve research and product development processes.


As a senior member of the team, you will also support and mentor colleagues, contribute to the coordination of research activities, and work closely with the Head of Product Development on product priorities and complex development initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:


Product Launch & Lifecycle Management

  • Contribute to the development and launch of new index and systematic investment products, from initial concept and research through methodology design, implementation, and commercial release.
  • Develop transparent, rules-based and investable methodologies across thematic, factor, smart-beta and other systematic strategies.
  • Prepare product specifications and methodology frameworks in collaboration with Product Development, Commercial, Index Operations, IT, Legal and Marketing teams.
  • Support the ongoing review and enhancement of existing products based on market developments, client requirements and product performance.


Python & Technical Development

  • Design and develop Python-based solutions for new and non-standard index products, including research, backtesting and implementation.
  • Write robust, reusable and well-documented Python code suitable for integration into production environments.
  • Work with large datasets to transform raw information into investment signals and automate research, rebalancing and other index-related processes.
  • Identify and apply appropriate AI and machine-learning techniques to improve research, data analysis, validation and product development processes.
  • Work closely with IT and Index Operations to transition new methodologies and solutions into production.


Research & Thematic Index Development

  • Conduct and coordinate quantitative and thematic research supporting the development of new index products, with a particular focus on identifying structural trends and translating them into investable strategies.
  • Evaluate themes, datasets, signals and investment hypotheses using structured and reproducible research approaches.
  • Develop rules-based thematic universes and methodologies based on macroeconomic, technological, societal and other structural trends.
  • Contribute to reusable research frameworks and tools that improve the efficiency and consistency of product development.
  • Support the prioritisation and coordination of research activities and provide guidance to junior researchers where required.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Work closely with the Head of Product Development and other teams on product priorities and complex development initiatives.
  • Collaborate with IT, Engineering and Index Operations to ensure methodologies and prototypes can be implemented reliably in production.
  • Support and mentor junior team members in quantitative research, Python development, code review, version control and index methodology design.
  • Contribute to best practices and technical standards within the Product Development team.


Client & Market Support

  • Support the Commercial team in client discussions by presenting product concepts, methodologies, research findings and performance characteristics.
  • Prepare client-facing analytics, scenario analyses and customised index solutions where required.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of market trends and client requirements to identify opportunities for new or enhanced index products.


Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. A Master’s degree, MBA, CFA, or comparable qualification is an advantage.
  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in financial services, including at least 3 years in index product development, systematic or thematic investing, or quantitative research, ideally within an index provider, asset manager, or fintech.
  • Index Expertise: Strong hands-on understanding of index methodology design, benchmark construction, rebalancing, corporate actions, and the index lifecycle, with experience developing and launching new index products.
  • Python & Data: Strong professional Python skills and experience developing robust, reusable solutions for quantitative research, backtesting, signal generation, and analysis of large financial datasets. Familiarity with software development best practices, including Git, testing, and documentation.
  • AI & Machine Learning: Good understanding of modern AI/ML techniques and practical experience applying them to financial data, quantitative research, or process improvement.
  • Thematic & Quantitative Research: Strong understanding of thematic investing and the ability to translate structural trends, investment ideas, and relevant datasets into transparent, rules-based methodologies.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Experience supporting or guiding research activities and junior colleagues, combined with strong analytical skills and business-fluent English. Ability to communicate complex concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience with databases, data pipelines, or workflow orchestration.
  • Knowledge of derivatives, structured products, or related index strategies.
  • Familiarity with relevant benchmark regulations and industry standards, including EU BMR, ESMA guidance, and IOSCO Principles.
  • Experience working in a fintech, startup, or fast-paced product environment, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.


What We Offer:


Global Team: Work in a collaborative, international, and flat-structured environment with direct access to senior leadership.

Dynamic Environment: Be part of a fast-moving fintech where innovation, collaboration, and pragmatic problem-solving are encouraged.

Meaningful Impact: Contribute directly to the development of innovative index products and help shape how new ideas move from research to market.

Duales Studium Wirtschaftsinformatik – Data Science (m/w/d)

Deine Aufgaben

  • Dreijähriges duales Studium ab dem 01.10.2026 mit Wechsel zwischen der dreimonatigen Theoriephase an der DHBW Stuttgart und der Praxisphase bei der riparo gmbh in Holzgerlingen

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

riparo mit Sitz in Holzgerlingen ist ein Dienstleister zwischen Kfz-Fachwerkstätten, Mietwagenunternehmen und der Kfz- Versicherungswirtschaft. Hierbei hat riparo die Aufgabe, die jeweiligen Netze zu verwalten und die Qualität zu sichern.

To strengthen our team in Wietmarschen-Lohne we are looking for a

Reservoir & Production Engineer - Data Analytics (all genders welcome)

Upstream optimization, an innovative division of the Rosenxt Group, which was spun off in 2023 and is dedicated to expanding into new business areas. Our focus is on developing advanced technologies for the optimization of energy production. Our state-of-the-art flow measurement device is a clamp-on non-intrusive system, gathering extensive real-time operational process data. To evaluate this data, we develop cloud-based software solutions that utilize classic signal processing algorithms and artificial intelligence (AI). In our interdisciplinary, agile, and autonomous teams, we foster innovations and customer value.

What You Can Expect

  • Analyze oilfield data, with a focus on production rates, field trends, and sensor data
  • Define and support strategies for oilfield operations and optimization
  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand workflows, provide analytical support and deliver actionable insights
  • Contribute to the development and validation of flow sensors and data-driven measurement systems, including well production optimization and reservoir optimization
  • Identify business needs, translate them into analytical requirements, and deliver effective, data-based solutions

What You Bring

To become part of the Rosenxt family, you have an analytical, structured and solution-oriented way of working. You should also bring:

  • Degree in Petroleum Engineering, Reservoir Engineering or a related discipline
  • More than seven years of industry experience, preferably with an oil & gas operator
  • Analytical mindset with high attention to detail and the ability to work intensively with data and software tools for extended periods
  • Solid background in reservoir and production engineering workflows
  • Good understanding of reservoir simulation techniques
  • Experience in data analysis using machine learning algorithms
  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken), with the ability to clearly present technical findings to colleagues and customers
  • Familiarity with industry-standard software (Petrel, ECLIPSE, Intersect, PETEX Suite, Kappa Suite)
  • Familiarity with production allocation, reservoir modelling, or digital oilfield workflows
  • Broader exposure to digital oilfield solutions and integrated workflows

Look forward to

  • Development opportunities and career opportunities in a global, innovative and long-term oriented group of companies with family character
  • Flexible working time and Home Office possible
  • An open, informal corporate culture, where we celebrate success with social events
  • Compatibility of work and family through our company-owned day care center

descriptionHtml:
At KWS, we are accelerating the discovery and development of innovative traits that help farmers meet future agricultural challenges. As a Computational Biologist (m/f/d) – Genome Editing Trait Discovery, you will play a key role in identifying and prioritizing candidate genes for genome editing traits by combining biological expertise, computational approaches, and data-driven decision making.

Working within our Gene Nomination team, you will act as an interface between biology, breeding, bioinformatics, and data science. You will help transform complex multi-omics datasets into actionable insights and support the development of next-generation approaches for candidate gene discovery, including Data Mining and AI-supported methodologies.

This permanent, full-time role is based at the KWS SAAT SE & Co. KGaA headquarters in Einbeck, Germany.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute biological expertise and domain knowledge to the development, validation, and implementation of AI-supported candidate gene discovery approaches.
  • Identify, analyse, integrate, and interpret complex multi-omics datasets to support candidate gene discovery and trait development.
  • Drive the prioritization and nomination of candidate genes for target traits and genome editing applications.
  • Provide computational biology support for research projects and stakeholders across Trait Discovery, Breeding Technology Applications, and related R&D functions.
  • Act as a scientific bridge between biology, breeding, bioinformatics, and data science teams, translating biological questions into data-driven solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging computational methods and innovative technologies to increase the speed, scalability, and impact of trait discovery
  • Opportunity to develop and lead own scientific projects focused on candidate gene ranking methodologies, knowledge discovery platforms, and data mining activities
  • Collaborate with data science teams to transition novel approaches into scalable and user-friendly workflows and platforms.

Bring Your Expertise

  • PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Plant Science, Data Science or a related discipline.
  • Strong experience in the analysis and interpretation of large-scale biological datasets, including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, or other omics data.
  • Proven expertise in applying Data Mining, machine learning, and/or AI-driven methodologies for candidate gene identification and prioritization
  • Good understanding of plant biology, plant breeding, genetics, genome editing, or trait development processes.
  • Proven experience in leading scientific or R&D projects is a plus
  • Experience with programming and scientific data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, workflow environments).
  • Entrepreneurial thinking and passion for innovation with a track record of developing novel solutions to scientific challenges.
  • Ability to effectively influence, collaborate, and drive outcomes across multidisciplinary teams in a matrix environment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus

Our offer

  • As a family-owned company, we live a culture based on the values of team spirit, closeness and trust, independence and foresight.
  • True to our motto "Make yourself grow", we encourage individual professional and personal development.
  • We create the right environment for you: Capital formation benefits, company pension plans, Christmas and holiday bonuses, childcare allowance, company bike.

Advance your career and grow with KWS! We look forward to receiving your digital application via our job portal.

descriptionHtml:
• HERMES Arzneimittel Holding GmbH
  • Pullach
  • Berufserfahrung
  • IT
  • Publiziert: 13.08.2026
  • Unbefristet

Wer Wir Sind

Seit 1907 setzt sich die HERMES Group mit Leidenschaft für die Gesundheit der Menschen ein und steht für höchste Qualität in der Pharma- und Gesundheitsbranche. Als Muttergesellschaft der Unternehmensgruppe übernehmen wir als HERMES Arzneimittel Holding eine zentrale Rolle: Wir stellen den Einzelgesellschaften HERMES ARZNEIMITTEL, HERMES PHARMA und Bad Heilbrunner essenzielle Funktionen bereit und fördern den nachhaltigen Erfolg der Unternehmensgruppe.

Du verbindest technisches Know-how mit analytischem Denken und möchtest die Basis für datengetriebene Entscheidungen schaffen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams als Data & Analytics Engineer (m/w/d) in Pullach bei München. Die Stelle ist unbefristet und in Vollzeit (37,5 Stunden/Woche) zu besetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Datenmodellierung: Du entwickelst, modellierst und optimierst Datenprodukte, Datenmodelle und semantische Schichten als Grundlage für moderne Analyse- und Reporting-Lösungen.
  • Reporting und Business Intelligence: Du konzipierst und realisierst aussagekräftige Dashboards, Berichte und Self-Service-Lösungen, die unseren Fachbereichen datenbasierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen.
  • Anforderungsmanagement: Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in intelligente Datenmodelle, Kennzahlen, Business-Logiken und analytische Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für das Unternehmen.
  • Datenqualität und Dokumentation: Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität, Transparenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit sicher und entwickelst unsere Data-&-Analytics-Plattform kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Datenanalyse und Prognosen: Du führst statistische Analysen durch und entwickelst datengetriebene Prognose- und Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Unterstützung fachlicher Entscheidungen.

Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du verfügst über eine IT-Ausbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Statistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit IT-Schwerpunkt.
  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Data & Analytics Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence oder Data Analytics gesammelt und bewegst dich sicher zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie.
  • Datenmodellierung und SQL: Du besitzt sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse und bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Modellierung analytischer Datenstrukturen sowie im Umgang mit modernen Reporting-, BI- und Analytics-Plattformen mit.
  • Datenplattformen und BI: Du kennst aktuelle Data-Warehouse-, Lakehouse- und Data-Platform-Konzepte und hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Power BI, DAX oder vergleichbaren semantischen Modellierungsansätzen gesammelt.
  • Analytische Methoden: Idealerweise verfügst du über Kenntnisse in Python, Statistik oder Advanced Analytics und bringst diese bei der Entwicklung datengetriebener Lösungen ein.
  • Persönliche Stärken: Du überzeugst durch analytisches Denkvermögen, Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

Unsere Benefits Auf Einen Blick

  • 37,5-Stunden-Woche mit Gleitzeit
  • 30 Tage Urlaub + Fenster-/Brückentageregelung
  • Kurzer Freitag
  • Subventionierte Kantine
  • Flexible Homeoffice-Regelung
  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen + freiwillige arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge & Unfallversicherung
  • Interessante Angebote zur Weiterbildung
  • Flexible Benefit-Auswahl z. B. ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei Kinderbetreuung, Urlaubszuschuss oder Business Bike Zuschuss
  • Lena Dorner
  • Talent Acquisition Specialist
