descriptionHtml:
Munich · Data Analytics · Leadership

We are looking for an experienced Analytics Team Lead you'll work with SQL, Python, Airflow and dbt, shipping analytical products and agentic workflows that serve senior stakeholders across Sales, Host Experience, and Customer Support & more and driving strategic decisions.


Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing vacation rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k vacation rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.


Your future team

You'll be joining and leading the analytics team at a pivotal moment. At Holidu, data isn't a support function — it's how the company decides. And as we scale, the bar for what analytics can deliver is rising fast.


We believe AI will fundamentally change the role of the data analyst, and we're looking for a leader who will guide the team through that transition and show us what great looks like.

The question is no longer "can you pull this number?" but "what data product do we need to build so no one ever has to ask us again?" Conversational analytics, automated reporting, agentic workflows — these aren't slides in a roadmap deck, they're what you and your team will be shipping.


If solving hard technical, organisational, business, and strategic problems excites you — you're in the right place.


This role is on-site in Munich, with two office days per week.


Our Tech Stack

  • Database: AWS Stack (Redshift, Athena, Glue, S3)
  • Data Pipelines: Airflow, dbt
  • Data Visualisation: Looker
  • Data Analytics: SQL, Python
  • Collaboration: Git, Jira, Confluence, Slack


Your role in this journey

You'll lead one of Holidu's core analytics teams — four analysts today, working alongside data engineering and data science, and serving stakeholders across Customer Support, Host Experience, Sales, and Account Management. It's a role with real surface area: the problems are messy, the stakeholders are senior, and the decisions you influence show up in the P&L.

Concretely, You Will

  • Lead from the front. This isn't a role where you stop doing the work. You'll be deep in agentic programming, exploring our data, and setting the bar for what great analytics looks like — both technically and in how we frame problems. If you've stopped enjoying the craft, this won't be the right fit.
  • Build the analyst of 2027, not 2023. You'll help define what AI-native analytics looks like in practice at Holidu — the tools, the workflows, the standards, the rituals. Your team will use Claude, Cursor, and whatever comes next as core instruments, not novelties. You should already be doing this yourself.
  • Ship products, not reports. Partner with stakeholders to identify the recurring questions, the broken workflows, the decisions made on gut, and turn them into analytical products that scale. Conversational interfaces, automated insights, decision systems — the category is wide open and we're betting on it.
  • Sit at the strategy table. As part of the BI leadership team, you'll shape the department's direction and represent analytics in the conversations that matter — product strategy, commercial planning, the road to IPO and beyond.
  • Develop people who'll out-grow you. Hire well, set sharp goals, give honest feedback, and build a team that people want to join and stay on. This is a leadership role; the multiplier matters more than your individual output.


Your backpack is filled with

  • 5+ years of data analytics experience.
  • Previous people management experience, with the proven ability to mentor and grow talent.
  • A collaborative mindset with clear experience communicating with executive stakeholders and senior decision makers.
  • A mission-driven, working-backwards mentality, starting from customer and business needs, managing complex multi-stakeholder projects, and translating goals into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
  • Excellent analytical and technical skills: strong SQL, Python (or similar), data visualisation, and the ability to develop technical frameworks that serve a clear business need.
  • A genuine commitment to AI enablement, you actively use tools like Claude Code or similar to enhance your own coding, planning, and workflows, and you're excited to bring your team along. AI fluency is not a nice-to-have here, it's part of how we work and how we evaluate impact.


Our adventure includes

  • Impact: Shape the future of travel with products used by millions of guests and thousands of hosts. At Holidu ideas become products, data drives decisions, and iteration fuels fast learning. Your work matters - and you’ll see the impact.
  • Learning: Grow professionally in a culture that thrives on curiosity and feedback. You’ll learn from outstanding colleagues, collaborate across disciplines, and benefit from mentorship, and personal learning budgets - with a strong focus on AI.
  • Great People: Join a team of smart, motivated and international colleagues who challenge and support each other. We celebrate wins and keep our culture fun, ambitious and human. Our customers are guests and hosts - people we can all relate to - making work meaningful and energizing.
  • Technology: Work in a modern tech environment. You’ll experience the pace of a scale-up combined with the stability of a proven business model, enabling you to build, test, and improve continuously.
  • Flexibility: Work a hybrid setup with 50% in-office time for collaboration, and spend up to 8 weeks a year from other inspiring locations. You’ll stay connected through regular events and meet-ups across our almost 30 offices.
  • Perks on Top: Of course, we also offer travel benefits, gym discounts, and other perks to keep you energized - but what truly sets us apart is the chance to grow in a dynamic industry, alongside amazing people, while having fun along the way.


Need a sneak peek?

Check out the adventure that awaits you on Instagram @lifeatholidu and dive straight into the world of Tech at Holidu for more insights!


Want to travel with us?

Apply online on our careers page! Your first travel contact will be Katharina from HR.


We are committed to diversity in all aspects of our business. We encourage applications from all genders, all corners of the world and all individual backgrounds. You are welcome to submit your application without a photo and without stating your gender, date of birth, marital status, nationality or disability status (if applicable). If you require any special assistance when arranging interviews, office visits or the recruitment process in general, please contact the relevant HR person responsible for this job and we will do our best to accommodate your needs.

Location Munich, Germany

Contribute to analytics governance, KPI standardization, and data quality initiatives in collaboration with the wider Analytics team. Support capability building and knowledge sharing across Digital, Product, Marketing, and Analytics teams, including stakeholder training on reporting tools and analytics capabilities. Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks. Proficiency in MS Office. Fluent English. BIRKENSTOCK is a global brand which embraces all consumers regardless of geography, gender, age and income. The company is deeply footed on a family tradition of shoemaking that can be traced back to 1774. With around 7100 employees worldwide, BIRKENSTOCK is the largest employer in the German footwear industry. To ensure our quality standards, we produce over 95% of our products in Germany and source more than 90% of our materials and components from Europe. The BIRKENSTOCK Group is headquartered in Linz am Rhein and maintains several locations in Germany, as well as sales offices in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end onsite analytics framework and KPI architecture across the customer journey, from homepage engagement and product exploration through checkout, purchase, and account creation.
  • Analyze customer behavior, conversion funnels, and drop-off points to identify optimization opportunities and improve business performance.
  • Support CRO, experimentation, and personalization programs by defining measurement plans and success metrics and evaluating test results in collaboration with Digital, Product, and Marketing teams.
  • Act as the single source of truth for onsite performance insights and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders across Digital, Product, Marketing, and E-commerce.
  • Contribute to analytics governance, KPI standardization, and data quality initiatives in collaboration with the wider Analytics team.
  • Maintain and enhance reporting and dashboard solutions to enable self-service analytics and identify opportunities to automate recurring analyses and reporting processes.
  • Support business trading and reviews with insights into onsite performance and navigation via ad-hoc analyses, larger projects, and reporting and dashboard development.
  • Share analytical best practices and guide stakeholders on data interpretation and usage.
  • Support capability building and knowledge sharing across Digital, Product, Marketing, and Analytics teams, including stakeholder training on reporting tools and analytics capabilities.
  • Leverage Digital analysis and insights to support other areas of the business, including Membership, Strategy, and Retail.


Your Experience And Competencies

  • Experience in Analytics and strong analytical skills and knowledge.
  • Experience in Retail, E-commerce, FMCG, or Fashion.
  • Proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong analytical mindset.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage and prioritize tasks and strategic priorities.
  • Stakeholder and project management skills.
  • Willingness to learn and develop both technically and strategically.
  • Motivation to work in a dynamic, diverse, and international environment.
  • Experience with Google, Adobe Analytics, and Contentsquare.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, including Tableau and Looker.
  • SQL and/or Python skills, including PySpark and Pandas.
  • Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.
  • Fluent English.


We Offer

BIRKENSTOCK offers you all the advantages of a successful, fast growing, global company: dynamic work environment, considerable design freedom, authentic and open corporate culture and excellent development opportunities. Sounds exciting? It is. Our Talent Acquisition team is looking forward to receiving your online application!

title: Chief AI Officer (m/w/d)
description: Wir denken an die Zukunft  – auch an Deine. Als Chief AI Officer verantwortest Du unsere unternehmensweite KI- und Analytics-Strategie sowie die Führung der unserer neu geschaffenen AI-Organisation. Dein Ziel ist die nachhaltige Wertschöpfung aus Daten und KI durch die Priorisierung und Umsetzung sowie Weiterentwicklung von KI-Initiativen, den Aufbau der notwendigen Fähigkeiten und Plattformen sowie die Sicherstellung einer wirksamen KI-Governance und eines verantwortungsvollen und regelkonformen KI-Einsatzes.Was Du bei uns bewegst Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer unternehmensweiten KI- und Analytics-Strategie, die konsequent auf die Geschäftsziele und die Transformation von Speira einzahlt. Identifikation und Priorisierung von KI-Anwendungsfeldern mit hohem Geschäftswert sowie Steuerung eines unternehmensweiten Use-Case-Portfolios. Beratung von Vorstand, Management und Fachbereichen zu KI-Potenzialen, strategischen Prioritäten und Investitionsentscheidungen. Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines skalierbaren KI-Operating-Models mit klaren Governance-, Rollen- und Entscheidungsstrukturen. Verantwortung für die zentrale Daten- und KI-Plattform sowie für die technologischen und organisatorischen Grundlagen einer erfolgreichen KI-Nutzung. Sicherstellung einer verantwortungsvollen, sicheren und regulatorisch konformen Anwendung von KI, einschließlich Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit und EU AI Act. Führung und Weiterentwicklung der KI-Organisation sowie Förderung von Talenten, Kompetenzen und bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit. Treiber einer daten- und KI-getriebenen Unternehmenskultur durch Wissenstransfer, Enablement und die Skalierung erfolgreicher KI-Lösungen im gesamten Unternehmen. Was Dich auszeichnet Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium der Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Mehr als 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und der Skalierung daten- und KI-getriebener Organisationen sowie in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung strategischer Transformationsinitiativen. Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner KI-Technologien, Machine Learning, Generative AI sowie Daten- und Cloud-Plattformen Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams sowie in der Entwicklung leistungsstarker Organisationen und Talente. Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, zwischen Business und Technologie zu vermitteln, kombiniert mit exzellenten Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills auf C-Level-Ebene. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Vorständen und Führungskräften sowie im Business Enablement zur erfolgreichen Einführung und Skalierung von KI- und Analytics-Lösungen. Hands-on-Mentalität mit der Fähigkeit, strategische Leitplanken zu setzen, gleichzeitig aber auch aktiv an der Gestaltung von Strukturen, Prozessen, Governance-Modellen und Betriebsmodellen mitzuwirken. Starker Fokus auf Wertschöpfung und Geschäftswirkung mit fundierter Erfahrung in Value Tracking, Benefit Realization und der Identifikation nachhaltiger Wachstums- und Effizienzpotenziale durch Daten und KI. Wir betonen ausdrücklich, dass bei uns alle Menschen - unabhängig von Geschlecht/geschlechtlicher Identität, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder Gleichstellung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung - gleichermaßen willkommen sind.Bewerbungen von schwerbehinderten und gleichgestellten behinderten Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung berücksichtigt.Dein Interesse ist geweckt? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! BewerbungsschlussAnsprechperson: Phillip VojinovicDu hast noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deinen Anruf unter: +49 2181 477 3008

(Senior) Team Lead Data Analytics | Munich | on-site 2 days/week


One of Europe's fastest-growing travel tech scaleups is looking for a senior analytics leader to own one of their core BI teams. It's a real IC responsibility, strategic visibility, and a genuine seat at the table.


The role:

  • Lead a team of 4 direct reports within the Business Intelligence department
  • You'll help define what AI-native analytics looks like in practice: the tools, the workflows, the standards, the rituals. Your team will use Claude, Cursor, and whatever comes next as core instruments, not novelties. You should already be doing this yourself.

  • Translate complex, multi-stakeholder problems into analytical requirements and communicate findings to both technical and commercial audiences

  • Help shape BI department strategy and the future of AI-powered data products

Stack: AWS (Redshift, Athena, Glue, S3) · dbt · Airflow · Looker · SQL · Python · Git · Jira


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of data analytics experience
  • Prior people management, this should not be your first leadership role
  • Track record of communicating with executive stakeholders and senior decision makers
  • Mission-driven, working-backwards mentality: start from business needs, deliver actionable insights
  • Strong SQL, Python (or similar), and data visualisation skills

Why it's worth a look:

  • The company treats data as a core decision-making function, not a support layer.
  • You'll work on products used by millions of guests and tens of thousands of hosts, with fast iteration cycles and real learning opportunities.
  • Up to 8 weeks/year working from another location is part of the deal.


📍 Munich | Hybrid (2 office days/week) | International team, 60+ nationalities

Interested or know someone who might be? DM me.

descriptionHtml:
At the Institute of Climate and Energy Systems Engineering (ICE-1) we focus on the development of models and algorithms for simulation and optimization of decentralized, integrated energy systems. Such systems are characterized by high shares of renewable energies and increasing sector coupling, which leads to high spatial and temporal variability of energy supply and demand as well as a high degree of interdependence of material and energy flows. Our research at the ICE institute aims to provide scalable and faster-than-real-time capable methods and tools that enable the energy-optimal, cost-efficient and safe design and operation of future energy systems.

Your Job

The transition toward renewable and converter-interfaced energy resources is creating increasingly fast and complex dynamics in modern power systems. In this Master’s thesis, you will develop a physics-informed digital-twinning approach to better characterize these dynamics and estimate relevant electrical and control parameters from transient voltage and current data.

Your tasks will include:

  • Developing and analyzing representative dynamic simulation scenarios for electrical power systems
  • Extending kernel-based Gaussian Process methods for the estimation of electrical and control parameters
  • Integrating physical knowledge, such as governing differential equations and physical constraints, into probabilistic kernel models
  • Developing and evaluating a physics-informed digital-twinning methodology based on known system parameters and reference simulations
  • Assessing the approach with regard to estimation accuracy, uncertainty quantification, numerical robustness, and computational efficiency
  • Analyzing and documenting your results and deriving conclusions for the applicability of the developed approach

Your Profile

  • Excellent university degree (Bachelor) in field of Data Science or a comparable field i.e. Electrical Engineering, Computer Science/ Engineering, Physics or the like
  • Strong mathematical background
  • Interest in energy systems, power grids and their components
  • Excellent knowledge and experience in programming Python
  • Excellent knowledge and experience in machine learning
  • Excellent ability for cooperative collaboration
  • Very good command of written and spoken English with extensive vocabulary is required (at least B2 level according to the CEFR

), ideally supported by a certificate confirming the language level. Knowledge of the German language is not mandatory but certainly appreciated

Our Benefits for You

We work on the very latest issues that impact our society and are offering you the chance to actively help in shaping the change! We offer ideal conditions for you to complete your studies:

  • Meaningful Tasks: Your thesis deals with a future-oriented, socially relevant topic with direct practical relevance in an international environment
  • Practical relevance: With us, you will gain valuable practical experience alongside your studies and actively participate in interdisciplinary projects, , including project meetings and, where appropriate, conferences.
  • Scientific environment: You can expect excellent scientific equipment, modern technologies, and qualified support from experienced colleagues
  • Personal responsibility: You organize your tasks independently - from preparation to implementation
  • Onboarding & teamwork: You can look forward to working in a dedicated, international, and collegial team. It is important to us that you quickly settle into the team and are given structured training for your tasks. We also support you from the very beginning and make your start easier with our Welcome Days and Welcome Guide
  • Work-life balance: We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your professional and personal life. You also have the option of flexible working (in terms of location), which is generally possible after consultation and in line with upcoming tasks and (on-site) appointments
  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours make it easier for you to balance work and study
  • Campus experience: Our research campus in the countryside creates ideal conditions for collegial exchange and sporting activities right on site. Our cafeteria offers a wide range of options—you can enjoy a relaxing lunch break with a lake view
  • Perspective: We provide strong support and mentoring to help you prepare for a future career in science or industry. If you have the appropriate qualifications and funding is available, the institute also offers the opportunity to pursue a PhD after completing your master's thesis
  • Fair remuneration: We will pay you a reasonable remuneration for your thesis

In addition to exciting tasks and a collegial working environment, we offer you much more:

https://go.fzj.de/benefits

We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds, e.g. in terms of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation / identity, and social, ethnic and religious origin. A diverse and inclusive working environment with equal opportunities in which everyone can realize their potential is important to us.

The following links provide further information on diversity and equal opportunities:

https://go.fzj.de/equality

and on specific support options for women: https://go.fzj.de/womens-job-journey

Apply now!Learn more jti.comProduct Intelligence Sensory Manager (m/f/d)Job ID 104744 / Location Trier / Start TBD Contract type permanentTo strengthen our R&D Tobacco Product Development team in Trier/Germany, we are looking for a Product Intelligence Sensory Manager (m/f/d) in permanent employment.Your job mission The role is vital for driving consumer-centric product development. You will apply your excellent statistics knowledge to contribute to sensory and consumer directed product development. Hence, you will translate product intelligence into actionables in line with business strategies. The ideal candidate has experience with AI and machine learning applications in sensory science or related fields.Who are we?JTI is a leading international tobacco company with locations in more than 130 countries and world-famous brands such as Winston, Camel and American Spirit. With our brands Nordic Spirit, Logic and Ploom, we also focus on growth through innovations in the field of reduced risk products. In Germany, we are the largest employer in our industry with over 2,000 employees.As a multiple award-winning top employer, we offer an open and inclusive working environment with exciting tasks in a challenging environment. Flexible working concepts, diverse development opportunities and international career paths are part of our everyday life. Visit us at www.jti.com to find out more about JTI and what it's like to work for us.Your tasks Analyze product sensory and related consumer data utilizing advanced statistic tools to report CAT (consumer affective tests) and QDA (quantitative descriptive analysis) projects. Create product intelligence related to consumer needs beyond regular sensory, gathering and analyzing consumer centric test data and focusing product development targets towards liking direction.Provide technical advice in sensory target setting and taste equity confirmation for product development and technical projects from product intelligence point.Establish and optimize sensory methodologies by developing customized testing methodologies in cooperation with stakeholders based on latest academic research and actively scout, present and discuss findings in the fast-moving consumer goods industry.Investigate and identify potential applications of GenAI in the data analysis and consolidation of sensory data and consumer insights, identifying patterns and generating insights to drive consumer-centric product development.Establish, manage and maintain global sensory panels and manage sensory panel evaluationsYour profile Relevant educational background Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Sensory Science, Food Science, Statistics, Data Science or a related field.Practical experience Working experience (3-5 years) in fast moving consumer goods industries, reduced risk products and other nicotine products development and/or sensory panel evaluation and consumer testing.Valuable knowledge Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in statistical analysis (e.g., JMP, R, SPSS, Python). Understanding of quantitative and qualitative research tools and methodologies, excellent knowledge of Excel, Power Point and of any sensory systems-ideally (e.g. RedJade, Fizz)Special strengths Experience with AI and machine learning applications in sensory science or related fields is advantageous. Fluent in English (written & spoken). Any other language is advantageous. German is considered as desirable. Suitable personality Ability to present complex data in a simple and powerful way through data storytelling, high level of attention to detail, ability to act self-confidently with internal and external partners.Practiced working time model Possibility of 50% mobile office work within Germany on a monthly basis. Occasional international travels. Your BenefitsYour team You will work in an open and international working environment with approx. 60 nations at the Trier site.Your remuneration Above-average pay including 13th and 14th monthly salary and bonus as well as annual reviews. Individual company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits.Your meals Our subsidized company canteen and numerous snack and coffee vending machines ensure your physical well-being.Your appreciation You will receive regular feedback from us and, as your personal safety is important to us, we also protect you in your private life with our JTI accident insurance.Your work-life balance You should enjoy your work! That's why we offer you 30 days of vacation for personal relaxation. You also have the option of doing mobile work in Germany for 50% of your working hours per month.Your mobility offer With our BusinessBike program, we offer you the opportunity to lease the bike of your choice at attractive conditions as part of a permanent position. This is an uncomplicated and flexible way to promote your health.Your development We focus on your personal development. We support you with a wide range of internal training courses as well as external training and development opportunities that are tailored specifically to you.Have we aroused your interest?Apply directly with your complete application documents (CV, cover letter & references) stating your earliest possible starting date (Job ID 104744).Diversity & InclusionWe want everyone at JTI to be themselves and develop their full potential, because each and every one of us makes a valuable contribution to the success of the company and the location in Germany. We live and promote diversity, equality and inclusion accordingly. We have local employee groups and networks, such as the PRIDE Chapter Germany or the togetHER network for female employees, in which committed colleagues are involved, and we support a wide range of projects in our local area. To strengthen our R&D Tobacco Product Development team in Trier/Germany, we are looking for a Product Intelligence Sensory Manager (m/f/d) in permanent employment.

Your job mission

The role is vital for driving consumer-centric product development. You will apply your excellent statistics knowledge to contribute to sensory and consumer directed product development. Hence, you will translate product intelligence into actionables in line with business strategies. The ideal candidate has experience with AI and machine learning applications in sensory science or related fields.

Who are we?

JTI is a leading international tobacco company with locations in more than 130 countries and world-famous brands such as Winston, Camel and American Spirit. With our brands Nordic Spirit, Logic and Ploom, we also focus on growth through innovations in the field of reduced risk products. In Germany, we are the largest employer in our industry with over 2,000 employees.

As a multiple award-winning top employer, we offer an open and inclusive working environment with exciting tasks in a challenging environment. Flexible working concepts, diverse development opportunities and international career paths are part of our everyday life. Visit us at www.jti.com to find out more about JTI and what it's like to work for us.

Your tasks

  • Analyze product sensory and related consumer data utilizing advanced statistic tools to report CAT (consumer affective tests) and QDA (quantitative descriptive analysis) projects. Create product intelligence related to consumer needs beyond regular sensory, gathering and analyzing consumer centric test data and focusing product development targets towards liking direction.
  • Provide technical advice in sensory target setting and taste equity confirmation for product development and technical projects from product intelligence point.
  • Establish and optimize sensory methodologies by developing customized testing methodologies in cooperation with stakeholders based on latest academic research and actively scout, present and discuss findings in the fast-moving consumer goods industry.
  • Investigate and identify potential applications of GenAI in the data analysis and consolidation of sensory data and consumer insights, identifying patterns and generating insights to drive consumer-centric product development.
  • Establish, manage and maintain global sensory panels and manage sensory panel evaluations

Your profile

  • Relevant educational background Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Sensory Science, Food Science, Statistics, Data Science or a related field.

  • Special strengths Experience with AI and machine learning applications in sensory science or related fields is advantageous. Fluent in English (written & spoken). Any other language is advantageous. German is considered as desirable.
  • Suitable personality Ability to present complex data in a simple and powerful way through data storytelling, high level of attention to detail, ability to act self-confidently with internal and external partners.
  • Practiced working time model Possibility of 50% mobile office work within Germany on a monthly basis. Occasional international travels.

Your Benefits

  • Your team You will work in an open and international working environment with approx. 60 nations at the Trier site.
  • Your remuneration Above-average pay including 13th and 14th monthly salary and bonus as well as annual reviews. Individual company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits.

descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is a pioneering international deep-tech company with locations in Germany and the US, dedicated to commercializing laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to deliver clean, safe, and virtually limitless energy to the world. As we rapidly scale, we seek talented individuals who thrive on bringing clarity and structure to fast-growing environments.

As a Experimental Scientist, you’ll build experimental capability in Darmstadt and help execute compression experiments at ELI Beamlines and other external facilities. Focused Energy’s Target Physics Risk Mitigation project requires experimental validation of foam compression and hydrodynamic instability behaviour in wetted foam targets this is an important input to the company’s path to ignition.

You’ll bridge experiment and simulation by operating shock and compression diagnostics, analysing experimental data, and running radiation hydrodynamic simulations that can be compared directly with experimental results. Working alongside the foam compression team, you’ll help deliver the project’s Q1 2027 milestones.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the execution of laser compression experiments at ELI Beamlines and other external facilities, including shot planning, diagnostic setup, and data collection.
  • Lead the operation of VISAR, SOP, and X-ray radiography diagnostics, building reliable procedures and deep diagnostic expertise within the foam compression team.
  • Drive radiation hydrodynamic simulations of foam compression and hydrodynamic instabilities using a multi-dimensional code such as FLASH or an equivalent.
  • Analyse experimental data comprehensively and document results in a form that supports physics interpretation and project reporting.
  • Compare simulation results with experimental data, clearly identifying areas of agreement, discrepancy, and uncertainty.
  • Build productive working relationships with ELI Beamlines and other facility partners to support beamtime access and campaign execution.
  • Improve the team’s understanding of foam compression and hydrodynamic instability physics by connecting experimental observations with simulation predictions.
  • Partner with Franzi Treffert, the Target Design team, and the simulation team on experimental planning, physics interpretation, and model validation.

Who You Are

  • You take ownership of your experimental and simulation workstream and manage day-to-day priorities without waiting for direction.
  • You are comfortable working independently in technically demanding, multidisciplinary environments.
  • You communicate experimental results, simulation findings, risks, and data-quality issues clearly in writing and team meetings.
  • You plan carefully and follow through across the full experiment cycle, from beamtime preparation through data analysis and reporting.
  • You use sound judgement when configuring diagnostics, selecting analysis approaches, and setting simulation parameters.
  • You recognise when a decision involves project priorities, experimental scope, or resource conflicts and escalate it appropriately.
  • You collaborate effectively with internal science teams and external laser-facility partners.
  • You are keen to build expertise, share reliable procedures, and support more junior contributors as the team grows.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience with laser compression experiments in high-energy-density physics, inertial confinement fusion, or a closely related field.
  • Knowledge of hydrodynamic instabilities, including Rayleigh–Taylor and Richtmyer–Meshkov instabilities.
  • Practical experience operating shock and compression diagnostics such as VISAR, SOP, and X-ray radiography.
  • Experience with radiation hydrodynamic modelling using FLASH or an equivalent multi-dimensional simulation code.
  • Strong data analysis skills using Python or a comparable scientific computing language.
  • Experience with HPC simulation workflows and computational experiment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with experimental design and shot planning for laser facilities.
  • Knowledge of Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis, Bayesian optimisation, reproducible scientific analysis, and systematic result documentation.

Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - in Münster or Munich (m/w/d)
description: Why this role existsEurope can reindustrialize if we bring together AI × Energy Market Opportunities × Industrial Processes. The largest European companies (~2% of total energy demand) make their energy decisions using our Energy OS.The mission statement we stand behind: Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.You are not rolling out a finished product. You are actively building the engine. You deploy our Agentic Energy OS at industrial sites. You are its teacher. You engineer how the tools execute. You enrich them with the energy insights you bring to the table. You iterate on customer feedback in hours, not quarters.AufgabenThe engine you co-buildThe Agentic Energy OS has four layers. You deliver into all four, and your field feedback rewrites them: Digital Twin: A live model of a customer's entire energy system: power grid, gas, steam at multiple pressure levels, cold/hot water, waste heat recovery, self-generation, batteries. Smart meter and OPC UA integrations. Calibrated to the customer's reality.2. Decision Hub: The investment-and-strategy layer. Designer scenarios, business cases, what-if analyses, roadmap planning across the customer's portfolio. Operation Hub: Cross-market, cross-plant live optimization. Day Ahead, Intraday Continuous, balancing energy. Calculates the internal merit order across the entire plant fleet, feeds prices and volumes into flex-marketer partners. The Autonomous Agent: The science fiction layer. Builds Digital Twins autonomously. Reads single-line diagrams, parses SharePoints, asks the right person for missing time series, researches component parameters, runs optimizations, finds savings in €/ton, uncovers contradictions in source data, and reports back.You are the driving instructor for autonomous driving. The agent needs you — to sit next to the operator, to hear what is said in the break room, to resolve contradictions the AI cannot see, and to stop it from emailing the entire purchasing department at 2 AM. Over time, your job becomes systematically automating away everything you still do by hand: you actively co-develop so that every workaround you find becomes obsolete. The site teaches the engine. You are the teacher.What you do on a Tuesday You work alongside agents handling a customer's chemical site: 12 process steam consumers across 3 pressure levels, an e-boiler option, a CHP (Combined Heat and Power) plant, a waste heat recovery loop. You review optimizations the agent has developed to compare a Power-to-Heat investment scenario against the status quo. descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Europe can reindustrialize if we bring together AI × Energy Market Opportunities × Industrial Processes. The largest European companies (~2% of total energy demand) make their energy decisions using our Energy OS.

The mission statement we stand behind: Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe.

You are not rolling out a finished product. You are actively building the engine. You deploy our Agentic Energy OS at industrial sites. You are its teacher. You engineer how the tools execute. You enrich them with the energy insights you bring to the table. You iterate on customer feedback in hours, not quarters.

Aufgaben

The engine you co-build

The Agentic Energy OS has four layers. You deliver into all four, and your field feedback rewrites them:

  • Digital Twin: A live model of a customer's entire energy system: power grid, gas, steam at multiple pressure levels, cold/hot water, waste heat recovery, self-generation, batteries. Smart meter and OPC UA integrations. Calibrated to the customer's reality.

2. Decision Hub: The investment-and-strategy layer. Designer scenarios, business cases, what-if analyses, roadmap planning across the customer's portfolio.

  • Operation Hub: Cross-market, cross-plant live optimization. Day Ahead, Intraday Continuous, balancing energy. Calculates the internal merit order across the entire plant fleet, feeds prices and volumes into flex-marketer partners.
  • The Autonomous Agent: The science fiction layer. Builds Digital Twins autonomously. Reads single-line diagrams, parses SharePoints, asks the right person for missing time series, researches component parameters, runs optimizations, finds savings in €/ton, uncovers contradictions in source data, and reports back.

You are the driving instructor for autonomous driving. The agent needs you — to sit next to the operator, to hear what is said in the break room, to resolve contradictions the AI cannot see, and to stop it from emailing the entire purchasing department at 2 AM. Over time, your job becomes systematically automating away everything you still do by hand: you actively co-develop so that every workaround you find becomes obsolete. The site teaches the engine. You are the teacher.

What you do on a Tuesday

  • You work alongside agents handling a customer's chemical site: 12 process steam consumers across 3 pressure levels, an e-boiler option, a CHP (Combined Heat and Power) plant, a waste heat recovery loop.
  • You review optimizations the agent has developed to compare a Power-to-Heat investment scenario against the status quo.
  • You catch a contradiction flagged by the autonomous agent — two single-line diagrams contradicting each other regarding a transformer rating — and fix it before the optimization runs on bad data.

The Career Path

We have a ladder with a deliberate branch at the Mid/Senior level. Choose the spike that fits you.

Junior — Onsite in Münster | ~60k

You learn the Agentic Energy OS from the inside out. Deliver in supervised deployments. Work with the Agentic Energy OS on real problems. Learn the missing skills, review, and iterate fast. Münster office, full-time, in person — this phase is your apprenticeship, and apprenticeships don't work remotely.

Mid — Industrial Cluster Track | ~80k Base + Upsell Bonus

You move out of Münster into the industrial clusters where the work happens — Rhine-Main, Rhine-Ruhr, Bavaria, Benelux. You are regularly onsite at one or more focus accounts: Pharma, Chemicals, Steel, Automotive. You own the end-to-end deployment, defend business cases at the C-level, expand RIZM's footprint within the account, and earn a bonus for every upsell at your focus companies. This is the commercial spike. Your successes are visible on the company's top line.

Mid — Backend Wizard Track | ~80k Base + Team Bonus

You stay closer to the engine room. Deep agent modeling, eval design, tool architecture, performance work, AI training pipelines, the agentic stack itself. You don't live on customer sites — you build the systems that make every Forward Deployed Engineer 10x more effective. This is the technical spike. Your successes are visible in every customer.

Qualifikation

What We Are Looking For

Three deep skill areas, plus one transversal strength. You need a strong spike in one of the three areas below, clear curiosity in the other two, and the transversal strength is non-negotiable: **you iterate quickly, treat customer feedback as the highest-priority input, and make yourself the fastest signal-to-engine path RIZM has.**

Applied AI Engineering — Frontier Startup Level

  • You treat hallucinations as an engineering problem, not a vibe. You can convince a customer's CISO that the agent won't go rogue.

Energy Intelligence — Enterprise Level

  • DACH / EU power market opportunities: Day Ahead / Intraday / Balancing Energy / Grid Connection — the significance must be familiar to you.
  • Energy system understanding: you understand physics and thermodynamics — you have a tattoo of the First Law of Thermodynamics.
  • Process understanding: you are razor-sharp at understanding production processes and their energy interactions.
  • Optimization intuition: you know what makes a numerical model slow before you even run it.
  • OPC UA, Modbus, OT network segmentation are familiar to you.

Commercial Ownership — the third spike

  • You sit down with the operator, the plant manager, and the CFO. You extract requirements they themselves don't know how to articulate.
  • You build the business case yourself. You don't wait for Product to do it for you.
  • You measure your own success in the reduction of EUR/unit at the customer, not in closed tickets.

Plus what we always look for at RIZM: agility, focused ownership, winning as a team, growth mindset, direct-but-empathetic communication.

Language

Today, we expect C1 German. Most of our customers run their operations in German, and the onsite work — the break room chats, the exchange at the OT level, the CFO whiteboards — happens in German. This threshold will drop as the customer base expands across Europe.

If everything else in this posting is a fit, but your German is not yet C1, apply anyway. We keep a focus list and will reach out as soon as we have an opening that fits you.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a Customer Success job teaching people how to use SaaS. It's about Agentic Co-Working.
  • Not a 9-to-5. The reindustrialization of Europe runs on a clock we didn't set.
  • Not an Algorithm Developer job.

Benefits

  • Stanford Engineering: Our technology is built on cutting-edge research from Stanford University. You can live your enthusiasm for sustainability and disrupt the energy industry with us.
  • Ownership & Impact: You will take direct ownership from Day 1, with the freedom to execute your ideas and see their measurable impact on our company’s long-term goals.
  • Mentorship & Coaching: We believe in raising the talent bar. You will work side-by-side with experienced leaders and industry experts who are dedicated to coaching you, guiding your development, and helping you become the strategic 'secret weapon' for our customers.
  • Competitive Package: We offer an attractive compensation package and a flexible environment that rewards performance and impact.

If you feel like this is a job might be the right fit for you, we are looking forward to your application!

If your profile is interesting, we will send you a short screening challenge before the first interview!

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

Tire solutions from the Tires group sector make mobility safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tire manufacturers. In fiscal 2025, the Tires group sector generated sales of 13.8 billion euros. Continental's tire division currently employs around 53,000 people worldwide and has 19 production and 16 development sites.

Job Description

Join Continental’s Digital Solutions Department as an MLOps Engineer

In Digital Solutions, we drive innovation for connected mobility and deliver cutting-edge digital products to our global fleet customers. As an MLOps Engineer, you will be at the forefront of transforming machine learning into scalable, production-ready solutions.

You will design, deploy, and maintain robust ML pipelines, ensuring seamless integration of models into production environments and optimizing their performance at scale. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will enable AI-driven insights that power smarter, safer, and more efficient mobility worldwide.

This position is intended to be filled on a full-time basis. However, applications for part-time employment will be considered in accordance with business needs.

Main responsibilities:

  • Design and manage CI/CD pipelines for ML models from development to production
  • Build and maintain scalable ML infrastructure on cloud platforms using infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate deployment, monitoring, and rollback processes for reliability and reproducibility
  • Implement monitoring and feedback loops for model performance and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate ML models and standardize workflows
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship, fostering knowledge sharing and best practices

Qualifications

  • Academic degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field
  • Several years of professional experience as a MLOps Engineer
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Expertise in CI/CD and automation tools (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with ML model deployment and lifecycle management (MLflow, SageMaker)
  • Good knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code practices
  • Familiarity with monitoring and performance tracking tools (Grafana) and workflow orchestration (Airflow)
  • Solid understanding of software engineering and DevOps practices (testing, GitOps, CI/CD design patterns)
  • Experience with Agile project management methods (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Proficient English language skills (written and spoken)
  • Experience working in an international team (desirable)

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

  • Attractive compensation: We reward exceptional qualifications and experience with an above-tariff salary, with the option of an above-tariff salary
  • Flexibility that fits your life: Whether mobile working, part-time models, flexible working hours, or sabbaticals – together we find a working model that suits your individual needs.
  • Time off that truly matters: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation per year.
  • Secure your future: With our company pension plan, we already invest today in your financial security of tomorrow.
  • Career with perspective: We actively support you in shaping your career through individual trainings, access to learning platforms such as LinkedIn Learning, and a wide range of development opportunities.
  • Borderless opportunities: As an EU citizen, you can work remote from other EU countries for up to 40 days per year – offering greater freedom and international flexibility.
  • Exclusive employee benefits: Take advantage of attractive discounts and a wide range of employee benefits.
  • Stay fit – nationwide: With our comprehensive range of health and wellness initiatives, you stay active – wherever you are in Germany.
  • Sustainable mobility: Use our “JobRad” bike leasing program and secure your preferred bicycle at attractive conditions – for more fitness, climate protection, and enjoyment on your daily commute.
  • A family-friendly culture: We support you with various offers that help balance work and family life, such as on-site childcare places and free emergency childcare services.
  • Support when it matters most: The Fürstenberg Institute provides you with a confidential external point of contact for professional advice and support in both personal and professional matters.
  • A work environment that embraces diversity: Look forward to working in a diverse and international environment through collaboration with our global locations.

For more information about the employee benefits you can expect at Continental, please visit our benefits page. If you would like to learn more about our location, feel free to visit our site page: Continental Hannover Stöcken / Hannover Corporate Headquarters.

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging are important to us and make our company strong and successful. We offer equal opportunities to everyone - regardless of age, gender, nationality, cultural background, disability, religion, ideology or sexual orientation.

If this sounds like a perfect match for you and if you want to become the next supporter of our core values: Trust, for one another, passion to win and freedom to act - we are looking forward to receiving your application.
